entity.summary: India-associated centralized cryptocurrency exchange providing current crypto-only spot markets across USDT and USDC pairs through the SecondBTC platform.
entity.notes: The current first-party domain loads the SecondBTC trading application, while independent exchange profiles report recently updated spot markets and non-zero activity. The exact operating legal entity, regulatory status, and exact launch date were not verified, so confidence remains medium and no licensing claim is made.
